scheduled_maintenances.name: Scheduled Zoom Software Quarterly Lifecycle Update (8/1/2026)

incident_updates.body:
As a reminder, approximately 30 days ahead of the upcoming enforcement, Zoom will enforce a new minimum version for the following areas on August 1:

Zoom Rooms (Windows, macOS, iPad, appliances, iOS and Android controllers)
	
Zoom Phone Appliances
	
VDI Client and Plugin

incident_updates.body:
Zoom will perform service maintenance at our Australia (Sydney) data center starting at 09:00 PM AEST (4:00 AM Pacific) on 7th August 2026. Zoom Contact Center users registered to the Sydney data center will be automatically registered in an alternative data center (Melbourne). During the maintenance window, a brief disconnection may be experienced and notifications may be missed. If you get disconnected, the system will attempt to reconnect you automatically. Once the Sydney maintenance completes, will perform the similar activity in Melbourne. 

If you are a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) customer, please ensure that your Session Border Controller (SBC) is configured with alternate routing to Zoom’s Frankfurt data center in addition to the Amsterdam data center. During the maintenance window, connectivity to Zoom’s Sydney data center will be blocked which will force calls from the Session Border Controller (SBC) to failover to Zoom’s Melbourne data center. Traffic will continue to be routed through the Zoom Sydney data center once the maintenance is completed.

scheduled_maintenances.name: Announcing IP Address Changes (No Operational Impact)

incident_updates.body:
The following new IPv4 subnet ranges will be deployed to Zoom resources for the Zoom Contact Center (ZCC) Flow Script and HTTP Call widgets, as well as the Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) Flow Script widget endpoints, starting no earlier than 30 days from the posting of this notice. We recommend that network administrators, with Zoom-specific firewall or network rules, update their systems as soon as possible in preparation.

In addition to the changes above, additional addresses for the Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA) HTTP call widget, AI expert assist, and knowledge base to sync content endpoints have been deployed and are in use. We recommend that network administrators, with Zoom-specific firewall or network rules, update their systems as soon as possible.

Removed IPv4 addresses for the ZCC Flow Script widget and HTTP Call widget endpoints:
79.72.1.202
80.225.76.19
84.8.104.187
84.8.110.17

New IPv4 addresses for the ZCC Flow Script widget and HTTP Call widget endpoints:
145.241.111.23
158.101.246.120
